sources.entry: Immich Kiosk - Lightweight slideshow for running on kiosk devices and browsers that uses Immich as a data source. (Clients) GPL-3.0 Docker/Go

summary.one_liner: Immich Kiosk is a configurable slideshow app that displays photos and videos from an Immich server on browsers and kiosk devices.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes it as a set of highly configurable slideshows for showing Immich assets on browsers and devices. It is listed in awesome-selfhosted as a lightweight slideshow client for kiosk devices and browsers that uses Immich as its data source. The README is brief and points to external documentation and a demo rather than listing features in detail. It states the project is not affiliated with Immich. The README links to a DietPi URL, but the link text and context are not given. Other specifics such as configuration options or display modes are not described in the README.
use_cases: display photo slideshow on a kiosk device
show Immich photos on a browser
digital photo frame from Immich library
showcase Immich assets on a screen
notable: Built to work with Immich as its photo source
Runs in a browser or on dedicated kiosk devices
Highly configurable slideshows, per the README
Documentation and demo linked from the README
caveats: README gives no installation steps; setup is documented externally
Not affiliated with the Immich project
Requires an existing Immich server as its data source
